detailed_description: Decision Wheel is a browser spinner over a small list of named options. It starts with three labeled options drawn as colored slices on a canvas wheel, with one option per slice and a pointer at the right. Edit option labels inline, add another option, or remove any extra slice (minimum two). Click Spin and a short cubic ease-out animation rotates the wheel, then the slice under the pointer is shown as the winner. A sound toggle plays a short sound when a winner is chosen if enabled, and Reset returns to the starting three options. The tool does not import lists, assign weighted probabilities, support image or video slices, export results, or persist options across page reloads.
usage_steps: Edit each option label inline in the list on the right
Click Add Option to add slices, or the trash icon to remove a slice (minimum two)
Optionally toggle the sound icon to enable or mute the win sound
Click Spin to start the animation
Read the winner shown in the highlighted card once the wheel stops
Click Reset to clear the result and restore the three default options
usage_examples: Pick a restaurant from a list of three to six options for a group dinner
Choose which task to start next from a small set of labelled options
Randomly pick a team member's name from a short list during a meeting
Decide between a handful of possible blog post topics with a quick spin
